name: jp.co.sugu-kuru/mcp-houjin-bangou
title: Japan Corporate Number & Invoice Check
description: Read-only MCP server for Japan NTA Corporate Numbers and Qualified Invoice Issuers (T-numbers).

environmentVariables.name: DATA_SOURCE
environmentVariables.description: Data source mode: 'web-api' (default local NTA Web-API) or 'db' (PostgreSQL bulk dataset; required for lookup_invoice_issuer).

environmentVariables.name: NTA_APPLICATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: National Tax Agency Corporate Number Web-API Application ID (required when DATA_SOURCE=web-api).
